name: Multi Vehicle Stereo Event Camera Dataset (MVSEC)
description: A multi-platform stereo event-camera dataset for 3D perception, including event streams, grayscale imagery, IMU measurements, and ground-truth pose and depth data.
citation: Zhu, A. Z., Thakur, D., Ozaslan, T., Pfrommer, B., Kumar, V., & Daniilidis, K. (2018). The Multi Vehicle Stereo Event Camera Dataset: An Event Camera Dataset for 3D Perception. arXiv:1801.10202. https://doi.org/10.1109/LRA.2018.2800793
